content:
Tumbling Tumbleweeds by Bob Nolan


Prelude:

[tab]        [ch]C[/ch]                     [ch]F[/ch]              [ch]C[/ch]
        I'm a roaming cowboy, riding all day long[/tab]
[tab]        [ch]G7[/ch]                    [ch]C[/ch]
        Tumbleweeds around me sing their lonely song.[/tab]
[tab]        [ch]F[/ch]                           [ch]C[/ch] [ch]Cm6[/ch] [ch]A7[/ch]
        Nights underneath a prairie moon,[/tab]
[tab]        [ch]D7[/ch]                      [ch]G[/ch]
        I ride alone and sing a tune.[/tab]

Chorus:

[tab]        [ch]F[/ch]                      [ch]F7[/ch]
        See them tumbling down,[/tab]
[tab]        [ch]E[/ch]                                 [ch]E7[/ch]
        Pledging their love to the ground,[/tab]
[tab]        [ch]F[/ch]                       [ch]C[/ch]        [ch]C#dim[/ch]
        Lonely but free I'll be found[/tab]
[tab]        [ch]G7[/ch]                               [ch]C[/ch]         [ch]C+[/ch]
        Drifting along with the tumbling tumbleweeds.[/tab]

[tab]        [ch]F[/ch]                           [ch]F7[/ch]
        Cares of the past are behind,[/tab]
[tab]        [ch]E[/ch]                           [ch]E7[/ch]
        Nowhere to go but I'll find[/tab]
[tab]        [ch]F[/ch]                         [ch]C[/ch]      [ch]C#dim[/ch]
        Just where the trail will wind,[/tab]
[tab]        [ch]G7[/ch]                               [ch]C[/ch]         [ch]C+[/ch]
        Drifting along with the tumbling tumbleweeds.[/tab]

[tab]          [ch]Fm6[/ch]  [ch]G7[/ch]             [ch]C[/ch]           [ch]Am6[/ch]  [ch]B7[/ch]             [ch]Em[/ch]  [ch]B7[/ch]  [ch]G7[/ch]
        I know when night has gone that a new world's born at dawn,[/tab]

[tab]        [ch]F[/ch]                       [ch]F7[/ch]
        I'll keep rolling along,[/tab]
[tab]        [ch]E[/ch]                           [ch]E7[/ch]
        Deep in my heart is a song,[/tab]
[tab]        [ch]F[/ch]                     [ch]C[/ch]      [ch]C#dim[/ch]
        Here on the range I belong,[/tab]
[tab]        [ch]G7[/ch]                               [ch]C[/ch]     [ch]C7[/ch]  [ch]C+[/ch]
        Drifting along with the tumbling tumbleweeds.[/tab]

Repeat from Chorus to end

Last time add:

[tab]        [ch]G7[/ch]                               [ch]C[/ch]
        Drifting along with the tumbling tumbleweeds.[/tab]
